افتضخنا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَضَخْنَا (iftaḍaḵnā) /if.ta.dˤax.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# اُفْتُضِخْنَا (uftuḍiḵnā) /uf.tu.dˤix.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
